exposure: Aggressive fibromatosis of the abdominal wall
Surgical resection (simple tumor resection vs tumor resection with abdominal wall tension-free repair using synthetic mesh)
outcome: Postoperative complications (incisional infection, incisional hernia, postoperative bleeding)
cohort: 24 patients treated for aggressive fibromatosis of the abdominal wall.
finding: Radical resection is an optimal treatment for patients with progressive aggressive fibromatosis of the abdominal wall, and synthetic mesh can be used for extensive abdominal wall defects with good outcomes.
